title: kv: windowed compactor and spill regulator for tenant-aware memory coordination
author: Asha Mehta
description: Motivation: We observed recurring tenant-level memory amplification and transient OOMs during mixed workloads (small chat requests + occasional long generation). Root causes were fragmented KV slabs and uncoordinated spill decisions that created cascading I/O pressure. This PR introduces a tenant-aware memory coordinator that schedules a windowed compaction pass and a rate-limited spill regulator to reduce fragmentation, smooth spill throughput, and improve tail latency. Design summary: 1) Windowed compactor: background compaction runs in configurable time windows per-tenant to coalesce fragmented segments without impacting short-lived latency SLOs. Compaction work is budgeted in CPU + device-time and yields are inserted to keep p99 latency stable. 2) Spill regulator: spill decisions are rate-limited and smoothed by a token-bucket style regulator per-device and per-tenant. Regulator exposes backpressure signals to the scheduler so batching and placement can prefer warm KV regions. 3) Tenant memory coordinator: centralizes fragmentation metrics and admission signals so we avoid simultaneous heavy compaction + spilling across tenants on the same GPU. 4) Evictor changes: eviction ranking now includes fragmentation risk score and recent compaction history to avoid repeatedly evicting the same hot prefixes. Implementation notes: - New modules: src/kv/compactor.rs, src/kv/spill_regulator.rs, src/kv/memory_coordinator.rs. - Metrics: kv.fragmentation_pct, kv.compactor.window_secs, kv.spill.regulator_fill, kv.spill.backpressure_events (per-tenant labels). - Config knobs: compaction_window_seconds (default 30s), compaction_cpu_budget_ms (default 25ms/interval), spill_regulator_rate_tokens (default 4/s), aggressiveness per-tenant. - Feature flag: kv.windowed_compactor (off by default for older deploys). Observability/telemetry: dashboards added in docs/ops/kv_compaction.md and console runbooks included for when kv.spill.backpressure_events > 50/min. Performance summary (canary): - Median token latency unchanged. - p95 generation latency reduced by ~6-9% under mixed workloads. - Memory churn (allocation hotpath) down ~18% in canary tenants. - In cluster soak we saw 62% fewer transient tenant OOMs during bursty load compared to baseline. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy as feature-flagged to canary nodes (10% traffic) for 48h. 2) Monitor kv.spill.backpressure_events and p95 serve latency; regress if p95 increases by >3x or spill regulator fill > 90% for >5m. 3) Gradual ramp to 100% over 7 days if stable. Backwards compatibility: default knobs safe; compactor disabled unless feature flag explicitly enabled. review_comments: Daniel Park: Can we add a safety cap so compaction can't starve inference threads? Suggest compaction_cpu_budget_ms default of 25ms/interval.
Asha Mehta (author): Added cap and explicit yield points; clarified in the compactor code comments and tests.
Marta Alvarez: How does the spill regulator react to transient I/O spikes? Will it delay required spill and cause memory pressure?

Asha Mehta (author): Regulator is conservative: on sustained I/O spikes it will raise a backpressure signal to the scheduler and accelerate eviction ranking for low-value prefixes. Added integration test to simulate I/O spike.
Ravi Singh: Please ensure tenant labels are included on new metrics and the console dashboards show top-10 tenants by fragmentation.
Asha Mehta (author): Metrics now include tenant_id labels and dashboard JSON updated.

release_notes: Introduce tenant-aware windowed compaction and spill regulator to reduce KV fragmentation and smooth spill throughput. Feature gated; default disabled. Observable via new metrics (kv.fragmentation_pct, kv.spill.regulator_fill, kv.spill.backpressure_events). Can reduce p95 under mixed workloads and significantly lower transient tenant OOM rate when enabled.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag kv.windowed_compactor is off by default. If enabling, follow rollout plan in docs/ops/kv_compaction.md. Watch kv.spill.backpressure_events and p95 generation latency; if backpressure_events persist, reduce compaction aggressiveness or lower spill_regulator rate. Console dashboard added under Storage > KV > Compaction.
